provenance: PLACEHOLDER: three short conversations written by hand to exercise the seeding; the real best-practices conversations replace them. No real person, organisation or project is described.
context:
Simulated, anonymous conversations with practitioners about how they used dembrane in their own work: what they set up before the first conversation, what they did during sessions, and what they did with the results. The people and organisations are invented.

Use this project to answer questions about using dembrane well. Ground every answer in what the practitioners say, name the conversation an idea comes from, and prefer their concrete steps over general advice. Where they disagree or a tip only fits one kind of setting, say so.
